template.name: template_map_info_item

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event: component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.375 * $scale * game.mapScale()) component("alignment"):SetInt(MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString("28/18") component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("layer"):SetString("$layer")

touchComponent.name: Touch
touchComponent.event: element.touchTimer = 0 element.isTooltipShowing = false element.shouldShowTooltip = false component:GetVar("passthrough"):SetInt(1)
local alpha = element.alpha or 1.0 if element.isVisible and alpha > 0.1 then element.shouldShowTooltip = true element.touchTimer = 0 end

event.name: onTouchDrag
event.params: component, element, x, y, relX, relY, dx, dy

touchComponent.event: if relX*relX + relY*relY > 64 then element.Tooltip:Hide() element.isTooltipShowing = false element.shouldShowTooltip = false end

if element.shouldShowTooltip then element.touchTimer = element.touchTimer + dt if element.touchTimer > 0.5 and not element.isTooltipShowing then element.Tooltip:Show() element.isTooltipShowing = true element.shouldShowTooltip = false end end

template.event:
--reset size element.Sprite("size"):SetFloat(0.75 * $scale * $spriteScale * game.mapScale())
local isVisible = element:GetVar("_isVisible"):GetInt() > 0
local spriteName = element.Sprite:GetVar("spriteName"):GetString()
local isSpriteVisible = spriteName ~= "" element:GetVar("_isSpriteVisible"):SetInt(isSpriteVisible and 1 or 0)
local showSprite = isVisible and isSpriteVisible element.Sprite:GetVar("visible"):SetInt(showSprite and 1 or 0)
local textWidth = element.Text:absW() local spriteWidth = isSpriteVisible and element.Sprite:absW() or 0 local totalWidth = textWidth + spriteWidth + $spacing element:setSize(lua_sys.Vector2(totalWidth, $height)) element.Sprite:GetVar("xOffset"):SetFloat(spriteWidth * 0.5)
